classification.difficultyReason: Standardise contextual measurements, then use symmetry and complementary probabilities to obtain population percentages.

content.prompt:
Pulse rates for adult males aged 20–39 are approximately normally distributed with mean 71 and standard deviation 9.

Use the standard normal table, rounding calculated $z$-scores to 1 decimal place.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Bradycardia is a pulse rate below 60 beats/minute. What percentage of this population has bradycardia? Give your answer to the nearest whole percent.

answer.worked:
Let $X$ be the male pulse rate in beats/minute.

$$\begin{align*}z&=\frac{60-71}{9}\\z&=-\frac{11}{9}\\z&\approx-1.2\end{align*}$$

By symmetry and the table,

$$\begin{align*}P(X<60)&\approx P(Z<-1.2)\\P(X<60)&\approx1-P(Z\le1.2)\\P(X<60)&\approx1-0.8849\\P(X<60)&\approx0.1151.\end{align*}$$

The percentage is approximately $0.1151\times100\%=11.51\%\approx12\%$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Tachycardia is a pulse rate above 100 beats/minute. What percentage of this population has tachycardia? Give your answer to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}z&=\frac{100-71}{9}\\z&=\frac{29}{9}\\z&\approx3.2\end{align*}$$

Using the table,

$$\begin{align*}P(X>100)&\approx P(Z>3.2)\\P(X>100)&\approx1-P(Z\le3.2)\\P(X>100)&\approx1-0.9993\\P(X>100)&\approx0.0007.\end{align*}$$

The percentage is approximately $0.0007\times100\%=0.07\%$.

inlines.text: for females aged 20–39 with mean 76 and standard deviation 9.5. Give both percentages to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked:
Let $Y$ be the female pulse rate in beats/minute.

Bradycardia:

$$\begin{align*}z&=\frac{60-76}{9.5}\\z&=-\frac{32}{19}\\z&\approx-1.7\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}P(Y<60)&\approx P(Z<-1.7)\\P(Y<60)&\approx1-P(Z\le1.7)\\P(Y<60)&\approx1-0.9554\\P(Y<60)&\approx0.0446.\end{align*}$$

The percentage is approximately $0.0446\times100\%=4.46\%\approx4.5\%$.

Tachycardia:

$$\begin{align*}z&=\frac{100-76}{9.5}\\z&=\frac{48}{19}\\z&\approx2.5\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}P(Y>100)&\approx P(Z>2.5)\\P(Y>100)&\approx1-P(Z\le2.5)\\P(Y>100)&\approx1-0.9938\\P(Y>100)&\approx0.0062.\end{align*}$$

The percentage is approximately $0.0062\times100\%=0.62\%\approx0.6\%$.
